text: Controlled substances, sedatives (such as ZenZ), and prescription-only medications require a valid physical prescription or authenticated digital prescription upon pickup. Plain photo copies or unverified messaging app snapshots are not accepted due to regulatory compliance.

Standard city deliveries arrive within 2 hours for orders confirmed before 7:00 PM on business days. Orders over $40.00 qualify for free express delivery. Temperature-sensitive items are dispatched in monitored thermal packaging.
We accept partner pharmacy benefit managers (PBM) including CarePass, MediHealth, and GlobalCorp Benefits. Co-pay discounts cannot be combined with clearance catalog promotions.
In compliance with health safety regulations, refrigerated items and opened medications cannot be returned or refunded once they leave the store premises.
